props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: slot
props.description: A slot name for the component.

props.name: id
props.description: Element id for the color area.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Handler called when the color changes.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: ID of element that describes the area.

props.name: aria-details
props.description: ID of element that provides detailed information about the area.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the area.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: ID of element that labels the area.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the area is disabled.

props.name: form
props.description: Associated form owner for the hidden range inputs.

props.name: value
props.description: The current color value (controlled).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default color value (uncontrolled).

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description: Handler called when dragging ends.

props.name: xChannel
props.description: The X channel to control.

props.name: yChannel
props.description: The Y channel to control.

props.name: colorSpace
props.description: Color space to use for channel axes.

props.name: xName
props.description: Name for the hidden X-axis range input.

props.name: yName
props.description: Name for the hidden Y-axis range input.
